source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus path separators and file bytes, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

observations.result: State, contracts, architecture, distribution metadata, strict typecheck, 58 tests with 253 expectations, Electron compilation, Knip and report-only Fallow health all pass; Fallow health is 89.0/A with only the pre-existing scripts/status.ts collectRow moderate advisory and documented distribution warnings.
No issues in the 19 changed implementation/test files for this P2.3 increment.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.
22 focused tests with 109 expectations cover preserved conflict bytes, explicit keep-incoming resolution, safe history/conflict IPC validation and the named external sync disposition list.
Main, preload and renderer bundles compile with conflict inspection/resolution, retention review/cleanup and sync-disposition IPC/UI wiring.

implemented: Added safe conflict-record inspection and explicit keep-current or keep-incoming resolution through VaultStore, including revision checks and protected-record cleanup only after the user action succeeds.
Added validated history-plan and cleanup IPC; cleanup removes only managed non-conflict recovery artifacts while protected conflicts remain retained and visible.
Added a non-modal history-surface conflict resolver with incoming-byte preview, explicit action buttons, retention summary and cleanup approval controls.

Added named contract-only dispositions for built-in Chronicle Git, Remotely Save, Syncthing, Dropbox/OneDrive and Obsidian Sync/Publish; unsupported proprietary access is visibly denied rather than implied.
limitations: The Electron binary is unavailable locally, so visible launch, accessibility-tree and cross-platform UI automation were not completed.
Retention policy values are still supplied by the default IPC policy; user-facing configurable policy settings, long-running retention tests and OS encryption readback remain pending.
Live external sync backends, per-tool OS/version certification, partial-sync integration, CLI/deep-link validation and reference Obsidian reopen tests remain pending.
